title: Dream of Jesse matching the Nas tweet reply

tellings.quote: And while I'm asleep, I have a dream about you coming to my house to get proolone

plain: Dylan Borland says that at his home on the East Coast he dreamed that Michels came to his house to get provolone cheese, and that the dream matched a reply to a tweet by the rapper Nas. He tells Michels this as a strange coincidence he experienced himself, the kind he takes as a sign that dreams can foresee real events.
